# Research manuscript (topic-ordered), 25 October 2026

Build: `cd handoff/manuscript && latexmk -pdf main.tex` (656 pages). Git-ignored research area (repo policy: research lives in `handoff/`).

* `legacy/` — copy of `handoff/research-third-decimal/handoff-2026-10-15/` (the 15–23 October manuscript), regenerated by `tools/annotate_stale.py`: it re-copies the originals (never edited) and inserts dated `\stale{<since>}{<note>}` markers after stale claims. Do not edit `legacy/` by hand; edit the originals or the script and re-run.
* `new/` — new chapters (`status`, `howtoread`, `why-the-gap`, `formalisation`, `withdrawn`) and fragments generated by `tools/convert.py` from the standalone notes in `notes/` (do not edit generated fragments; edit `notes/*.src.tex` and re-run).
* `notes/` — sources: `attack_analysis.src.tex` (22–23 Oct analysis), master's `docs/research/*.tex` standalone notes, `docs/localized-comparison.tex`, `WHY_THE_GAP.md`, `PLAN_MOVE_NEEDLE.md`.
* LaTeX resolves `\input{chNN-...}` through `\input@path{legacy/}` (set in `new/preamble.tex`).

Only the opening chapter *Status at a glance* has current numbers (master 899d946: 1.401695322458 < K < 1.404598161566; hypothesis-free K ≤ 1.404951). All other chapters are dated records; see GitHub issue #38 for the list of chapters whose stated endpoints are outdated.
